bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you cast a spell that deals energy damage, you may change that damage and the spell's energy type to match your selected element.

powers.name: Elemental Ray
powers.summary: Make a ranged touch attack within 30 feet for 1d6 damage of your selected energy type plus 1 per two sorcerer levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Elemental Resistance
powers.summary: Gain resistance 10 against your selected energy type, increasing to resistance 20 at 9th level.

powers.name: Elemental Blast
powers.summary: Create a 20-foot-radius burst within 60 feet for 1d6 energy damage per sorcerer level, Reflex half; failed saves also gain vulnerability until the end of your next turn. Uses increase at 17th and 20th levels.

powers.name: Elemental Movement
powers.summary: Gain the movement type or speed bonus associated with your selected element.

powers.name: Elemental Body
powers.summary: Gain immunity to sneak attacks, critical hits, and damage from your selected energy type.

bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you cast a spell of the compulsion subschool, increase its save DC by 2.

powers.name: Laughing Touch
powers.summary: Cause a creature touched to laugh for 1 round, limiting it to a move action while retaining normal defenses. Each creature is immune for 24 hours after being affected. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Woodland Stride
powers.summary: Move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment, though magically manipulated plants still impede you.

powers.name: Fleeting Glance
powers.summary: Become invisible as greater invisibility for rounds per day equal to sorcerer level, divided as desired.

powers.name: Fey Magic
powers.summary: Reroll caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance at will, deciding before the result is revealed and taking the second result.

powers.name: Soul of the Fey
powers.summary: Gain immunity to poison, DR 10/cold iron, protection from uncommanded animals, and shadow walk once per day as a spell-like ability.
